namespaceRole.description: ADR-019 D-5 role. 'local' is a resource namespace — requires globalConfigNamespace, accountId, and region, and renders all three placement annotations. 'global' is a governance-only namespace — renders none of those annotations and does not need those three fields.

globalConfigNamespace.description: Namespace holding the global-tier KropathConfig/<Family>Config baseline. Required (and must be non-empty) when namespaceRole is 'local'; unused when 'global'.

accountId.description: 12-digit AWS account ID (ADR-015 §5.8.2 rule 1). Required (and pattern-checked) when namespaceRole is 'local'; unused when 'global'.

region.description: AWS region, e.g. ap-southeast-2. Required (and must be non-empty) when namespaceRole is 'local'; unused when 'global'.

kropathConfig.description: Optional spec.mandatory/spec.defaults overrides for KropathConfig/baseline. Both default to {}.

families.description: Family slug -> {enabled, mandatory, defaults} or null (a bare 'slug:' entry is equivalent to {}: enabled defaults to true, mandatory/defaults default to {}). See family-kind-map.yaml for accepted slugs.
